records.subject: A quick nudge about your Wrenfield workspace
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Following up to see how things are going. If Wrenfield isn't the right fit, that's useful to know too -- either way I'd appreciate a reply.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Anything I can help with?
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Saw you brought a teammate in -- nice. How's it going so far for both of you?

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Orchard Analytics!
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Welcome to Wrenfield -- excited to have Orchard Analytics here. If you get stuck on anything in the first few days, just reply to this email directly and it'll come straight to me.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Orchard Analytics* just joined on the pro plan!

decisions.rationale: Account is engaged (getting started call held [calendar:ebff5901], one invite sent) but 6 days in with no first project and no replies to two Wrenfield emails [email:f5731cc6], [email:7b3b8a59]. Pro plan and an active teammate suggest intent; silence plus no project after a call lowers odds within the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: Getting Orchard Analytics' first project going
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks again for making time for the getting started call last week — and good to see you've already brought a teammate into Wrenfield.

The usual next step is setting up your first project: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and I'm happy to walk through it with you too.

Would a short call this week work? I can help you map your first project structure so you and your teammate can start working in it right away.

Best,
Priya
